journey_boundaries.profile_display: Read personal details from Identity Account; do not infer a live self-service update API from copy.
journey_boundaries.profile_save: Only confirmed Identity mutation may show saved; validation, failure, concurrency conflict, uncertain response and retry remain distinct.
journey_boundaries.primary_email: Current canonical email is displayed read-only in this prospective surface; email changes use separately governed reauthentication, proof and guarded apply, not profile-save.
journey_boundaries.verification: Verified/unverified/unknown account state is derived only from current Identity authority, not copy, delivery or a cached browser claim.
journey_boundaries.language_anonymous: Language choice locally persisted before registration/login; not an Account write.
journey_boundaries.language_authenticated: After registration/login, preferred interface language saved through Identity; only confirmed persistence may show saved.
journey_boundaries.language_content_independence: The language of separately chosen content is not automatically changed by interface language.
journey_boundaries.language_availability: No silent fallback for required EN/AF content; reuse the existing required-content-unavailable semantic key.
journey_boundaries.concurrency_idempotency_retry: Read current Account before mutation; prevent stale overwrite; identical confirmed retries converge, conflicting/uncertain results require current-state reread. Do not fabricate success.

explicit_non_goals: No Account/profile update actions implemented or presumed to exist.
No change to registration copy or existing copy keys.
No direct email address edit; use the separately approved primary-email-change journey when authorised.
No personal health data, date of birth, profile assessments, consent, marketing or subscription features.
No production/public/real-participant release authorization and no new governance/Plane authority.
